description: This file defines a snapshotter injected into the browser context for capturing DOM and stylesheet snapshots, including mutation observation and style sheet management, used within Playwright's tracing and recording features.

classes.name: Streamer
classes.description: A class responsible for capturing DOM snapshots, managing style sheets, and observing mutations to generate consistent page state representations.

methods.name: frameSnapshotStreamer
methods.description: Initializes the snapshot streamer in the browser window, setting up mutation observers, style sheet interceptors, and snapshot capturing logic.
